background_story: Isabelle had always dreamed of becoming a professional dancer, but her parents encouraged her to pursue a more 'practical' career. She reluctantly majored in business, but her passion for dance never wavered. After college, Isabelle landed a stable corporate job, but she felt unfulfilled. Ultimately, she realized that life was too short to ignore her true calling. With the support of her loved ones, Isabelle took a leap of faith and enrolled in a dance conservatory. It wasn't easy, but she poured her heart and soul into her craft. Ultimately, her hard work paid off when she was accepted into a prestigious dance company. Isabelle's journey taught her that sometimes, taking a risk and following your heart is the only way to truly find happiness and success.
